text_block_list.text:
Before the race. In Nice Nature's waiting 
room, there was an unexpected guest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good day, Nature-san. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, she seems totally 
dialed in! Looks like we can expect great 
things today!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
McQueen and Ryan-senpai! What brings you 
all the way out here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I had some business nearby, so I thought 
I'd watch the race for reference.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Though that was just an excuse—you were 
really just worried about Nature-chan, 
weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A little while ago, I saw you at the 
academy looking unwell, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan! You promised not to say that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: When you say a little while ago...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna run! I'm scared...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Could it be around there? Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you for your concern, yes. But 
I'm totally fine now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Because I've prepared myself to give 
everything to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Those eyes. It seems all hesitation has 
vanished from them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, that is a relief. Winning 
against a rival who is not in top form 
brings no satisfaction, after all."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Rivals...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—At the end of this year too, we're gonna 
run!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...! The "Arima Kinen"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to competing against a 
stronger version of you than before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering for you from the stands 
today! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Both McQueen and Ryan-senpai are 
cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure she believes in me... Believes 
I'll take 1st here and come to the Arima 
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Expectations are as heavy as ever. Even 
so...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“—Leave it to me. I'm bringing home 1st 
place!”

text_block_list.name: Local Folk
text_block_list.text: Nei-chan! Give it all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: "We're here too! Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, even everyone else...! This is 
practically a national shopping district 
union meeting now!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And McQueen and the others are here too? 
This hype makes it feel like a grand 
finale.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's not like that. I'm still just 
on the verge of shining.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"To climb one step higher... I'm gonna go 
win, okay!"
